title: Concept: Neo4j error detail disclosed in a response
description: A Neo4j Cypher syntax error echoing the query in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Cypher error text repeats the offending fragment of the query, which reveals labels and relationship names of the fraud graph.
applicability: Deployments that render a Neo4j Cypher syntax error echoing the query into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Cypher error text repeats the offending fragment of the query, which reveals labels and relationship names of the fraud graph.
